home.description: Tap a cell to change its color. Its new color depends on the colors of its neighbours, but the rules are secret and every puzzle has its own.
home.how1: Start from the green cell with the flag.
home.how2: Turn the cell with the checkered flag green to win.
home.how3: Experiment, find out the rules, then solve it in as few moves as you can.
home.loadError: The puzzles could not be loaded. Please check your connection and reload the page.
home.privacy: No sign-up, no cookies. To improve the puzzles we record anonymous game data (moves and results) grouped by a random number that is forgotten when you close the page. Nothing that identifies you is stored.
